title: Evercore Wealth Management Promotes Sean Brady to Partner
summary: Evercore Wealth Management today announced the promotion of Sean Brady to partner. Mr. Brady is a wealth & fiduciary advisor at Evercore Wealth Management and its affiliate, Evercore Trust Company.
body_markdown: Evercore Wealth Management today announced the promotion of Sean Brady to partner. Mr. Brady is a wealth & fiduciary advisor at Evercore Wealth Management and its affiliate, Evercore Trust Company.
